candidates.source_name: ЕСЈН — Електронски систем за јавни набавки (e-nabavki.gov.mk) Public Access portal
candidates.why_relevant: Single national tender portal. Every contracting authority (договорен орган) must publish notices, tender dossiers, award decisions and 'известување за склучен договор' here. Notices for банкарски услуги, платен промет, ПОС терминали, е-плаќање and core-system consultancy carry the buying unit's contact officer, the winning economic operator and often the key-expert/CV requirements — a direct read on who staffs payments programmes on the public route and a master pointer to the supplier population.
candidates.access_status: public portal; anonymous browse of Public Access section; full bidding requires registered account and annual subscription
candidates.legal_status: official government publication, public by law (Закон за јавните набавки)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the Public Access notice/award lists filtered by CPV (66100000 banking/financial services, 30144200/30142000 payment terminals, 72000000 IT services) and by MK keywords; ASP.NET grid pages need session/viewstate-aware fetching or headless browser; export CSV where offered.
queries_used: e-nabavki.gov.mk оглас набавка на банкарски услуги договорен орган
Биро за јавни набавки Република Северна Македонија известување за склучен договор
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch of https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/home.aspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden — hypothesis: bot-defended but live (portal is widely linked and cited); unverified, not dead.

candidates.source_name: ЕСЈН — Склучени / Реализирани договори (concluded and realised contracts grid)
candidates.why_relevant: Institution-by-institution grid of concluded and realised contracts with supplier name and value. This is the award-side view: which vendor won a bank/POS/e-payment contract for which public buyer, and therefore which supplier is about to staff or expand a delivery team.
candidates.access_status: public; machine-readable CSV export reported for concluded-contracts sections
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic CSV export / grid scrape per contracting authority; diff against previous snapshot to detect new payments-related awards.
queries_used: Биро за јавни набавки Република Северна Македонија известување за склучен договор
opendata.gov.mk отворени податоци јавни набавки податочен сет ЕСЈН

candidates.source_name: Биро за јавни набавки (Public Procurement Bureau, BJN) — bjn.gov.mk
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator/operator of the ESJN. Publishes rulebooks, ESJN user manuals, annual public-procurement reports and news (e.g. announcement that concluded contracts are published on ESJN). Its guidance defines what fields award notices must contain — essential for building a reliable extraction schema — and its reports name market structure and top suppliers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor /novosti and publications/PDF library; parse annual reports for supplier concentration in CPV 66/72 categories.
queries_used: Биро за јавни набавки Република Северна Македонија известување за склучен договор

candidates.source_name: Министерство за финансии — Биро за јавни набавки / Е-јавни набавки institutional pages
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry-of-Finance side of the procurement machinery; also links the ministry's own tender notices. MoF is the buyer for treasury/payment-system related consultancy and for the state's banking arrangements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /mk-MK/javni-nabavki and the BJN subpage; archive PDFs of tender dossiers.
queries_used: e-nabavki.gov.mk оглас набавка на банкарски услуги договорен орган
local_language_terms_used: огласи и договори за јавни набавки

candidates.source_name: Трезор — Treasury Department, Ministry of Finance
candidates.why_relevant: The Treasury runs the single treasury account, the register of budget users and all денарски/девизни payment execution for the public sector. Organisational notices, treasury-operations instructions (Упатство за начинот на трезорско работење) and reform announcements reveal who owns public payment rails and when a payment-system change is coming that will need vendors and staff.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch Трезор and 'Извештаи Трезор' pages plus linked PDFs; cross-reference with ESJN notices from MoF.
queries_used: Трезор Министерство за финансии платен промет буџетски корисници банкарски услуги договор

candidates.source_name: Open Finance портал (open.finance.gov.mk) — public spending transactions
candidates.why_relevant: Transaction-level publication of budget-user spending. Payments to named suppliers for banking/POS/IT services corroborate ESJN awards and expose contracts that never surfaced as a visible tender, plus ongoing consultancy burn rates.
candidates.access_status: public portal with user guide PDF
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query/export by institution and supplier name; join on supplier names harvested from ESJN awards.

candidates.source_name: Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки (DKZJN) — appeals decisions
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes complaints received daily and the decisions taken at sessions. Appeal files in banking/POS/IT tenders name the bidders, the disputed technical/staffing criteria (often key-expert qualification requirements) and the contracting authority's officials — an unusually rich, named view of the supplier and expert population that award notices summarise only briefly.
candidates.access_status: open web; also a mirror at dkzjn.mk and an app instance at dkzjn.sorsix.com
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the decisions/complaints listing, OCR/parse PDFs, filter for банкарски услуги / ПОС / платежен / софтвер keywords.
queries_used: Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки dkzjn.mk одлуки

candidates.source_name: Државен завод за ревизија (State Audit Office, DZR) — audit reports on institutions
candidates.why_relevant: Regularity/performance audits of the National Bank, DKZJN, ministries and public enterprises routinely detail procurement of banking and IT services, contract values, and internal organisational units — a retrospective but highly reliable read on who buys payments capability and how the buying unit is structured.
candidates.access_status: open web, taxonomy pages per audited entity
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl per-entity taxonomy pages (e.g. /mk/taxonomy/term/412 for NBRM), download report PDFs, keyword-filter.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from NBRM and DKZJN searches

candidates.source_name: Народна банка на РСМ — Јавни набавки (central bank procurement)
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank is itself a contracting authority and the operator/overseer of national payment systems (MIPS, oversight of KIBS). candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU)

TA contract notices and awards list the winning consortium and, in the ToR, the key-expert positions (team leader, senior/junior experts) with required profiles — the most explicit public statement of who is being staffed onto a payments/PFM programme.

Also names EBRD/EIB-channelled financial-sector facilities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest annual IPA action-document PDFs for MK, text-extract, filter for payments/PFM/financial-sector, then match to later TED notices.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of the ESJN Public Access homepage (https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/home.aspx) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page content retrieved. Treated as bot-defence on a live portal, not as a dead source — the domain is heavily linked from BJN, MoF and news sources and its subpages appear in current search indexes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell will need a headless browser or session-aware fetcher rather than a plain HTTP client; plan collection tooling accordingly and re-verify liveness in the deterministic pass.

negative_findings.description: No specific MK public tender or award notice for a payment gateway / card acceptance / POS deployment could be surfaced through web search in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk queries ('ПОС терминали' јавна набавка, набавка на банкарски услуги) returned the portal, ministry procurement index pages and commercial bank POS marketing pages, not individual notices. en queries returned donor/aggregator pages only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ESJN notice pages appear to be poorly indexed by general search engines (dynamic ASP.NET grids), so keyword web search is NOT a viable discovery channel for individual notices — collection must go through the portal's own search/export or the open-data extracts.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific commercial tender-aggregator brand (e.g. a 'tenderi.mk' style local subscription service) was confirmed to exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: The mk query for local aggregators returned only official .gov.mk portals plus Montenegro's cejn.gov.me; only international aggregators (DevelopmentAid, GTBC, SellToState/Hook) were found covering MK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a local-language aggregator exists it would be a cheap normalised feed; its apparent absence means the collection burden falls on the official portal and on international aggregators with weaker MK depth.

negative_findings.description: No published award notice naming key experts or a contract project manager on an MK banking/payments public contract was located within this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one concrete tender dossier PDF (Customs, 2017) and one named donor consultancy role (UNDP IC 868-2026 National Sustainable Finance & Institutional Specialist) were found at the named-person/named-role level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The named-people signal this cell promises is real but sits inside PDF dossiers and appeal files, not in search-indexed HTML — extraction design must be PDF-first.

coverage_gaps.description: The ESJN portal's own search interface, its CPV filtering, and whether anonymous users can browse concluded-contract detail pages (vs. needing a subscribed account) were not established, because the portal 403'd.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser probe of e-nabavki.gov.mk Public Access: map the notice search form, CPV filter parameters, pagination and any CSV/Open Data export endpoint; document whether an account is required.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal and public-enterprise contracting authorities (општини, ЈП Водовод, ЕСМ, Пошта на Северна Македонија, ФЗОМ, ПИОМ) were not individually enumerated, yet they are the volume buyers of card acceptance and e-payment collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the full ESJN institution list (InstitutionGridData) as the authoritative contracting-authority registry, then prioritise entities with citizen-facing collections; add Пошта and the health/pension funds as named watch targets.

coverage_gaps.description: IFI procurement routes outside the EU (EBRD, World Bank, EIB) that fund MK financial-sector and PFM work were referenced only in passing; their own procurement notice boards were not scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout EBRD Procurement Notices, World Bank Procurement (STEP/Business Opportunities) and EIB for MK financial-sector/PFM contracts and their consultant selection notices, which publish shortlisted firms and expert requirements.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage was not attempted, although Albanian is an official language and municipal contracting authorities in western MK publish in it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq glossary terms (prokurimi publik, njoftim per kontrate te lidhur, sherbime bankare, terminale POS) and re-run discovery against municipal sites and the portal's Albanian interface.

coverage_gaps.description: No validated CPV code list for the payments/banking scope was assembled, and MK CPV usage was not observed on any real notice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Derive the working CPV set empirically from ESJN/TED award data for MK (banking/financial services, payment terminals, transaction processing software, IT consultancy) rather than assuming the EU codes are applied consistently.

brief: The MK public-procurement route is highly centralised: ESJN (e-nabavki.gov.mk), operated by the Биро за јавни набавки under the Ministry of Finance, is the mandatory publication point for notices, award decisions and 'известување за склучен договор' from every contracting authority, with an institution-level concluded/realised-contracts grid and CSV/open-data extracts alongside it. The named-people signal this cell targets — buying-unit contact officers, winning economic operators, and key-expert requirements — sits mostly inside PDF tender dossiers, DKZJN appeal decisions and donor ToRs (TED/IPA, UNDP-MKD individual-consultant notices such as the National Sustainable Finance & Institutional Specialist role) rather than in search-indexed HTML. Two practical constraints shape collection: the portal returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch (bot-defended, presumed live) so a headless/session-aware crawler is required, and general web search does not index individual MK notices, so discovery must run through the portal's own search plus open-data exports. Independent corroboration and prioritisation come from the Center for Civil Communications monitoring reports, the State Audit Office, Open Finance transaction data and international aggregators (paywalled, do not scrape).
